title: Normalize country code in checkout
description: Frontend sends full country names ('United States'); backend expects ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes ('US'). This causes a 502 on checkout submission. Normalize on the frontend before submission and add explicit backend validation.
acceptance_criteria: Frontend converts country display names to ISO-2 codes before submitting
Backend validates and rejects non-ISO-2 values with 422 + descriptive error
E2E test covers: US, CA, GB, and invalid 'United States' input
No regressions in existing checkout flow
